title: Empowering cloud network operation with self-intelligence through the network large model toolchain platform
summary: China Telecom describes an internal model-and-agent toolchain intended to streamline cloud-network operations and collaborative development.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The toolchain combines telecom data processing, knowledge management, model training, and agent deployment. An internal pilot is described, with broader use and concurrent-user targets planned. The source does not provide an achieved time, cost, or service-quality comparison.
purpose: Streamline telecom model development and intelligent-agent operations.
system: Empowering cloud network operation with self-intelligence through the network large model toolchain platform

ratings.reason: China Telecom describes an internal toolchain pilot and future coverage targets, without an observed cost or quality comparison.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: Empowering cloud network operation with self-intelligence through the network large model toolchain platform

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A telecom model toolchain supports intelligent-agent development
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
